text:
matt: Heads up — after yesterday's merge that swaps to the new fused-FA kernel with the 32x32 smem tiling we see a 12-18% p99 latency regression on long-context requests (>8k). noticing memory-bandwidth jumps in the profiler. anyone else?

sara: saw this in the nightly smoke too. interestingly the KV cache hit rate dropped a bit for those traces — more kv spills to global. could be shared memory pressure causing cache evictions. cc @raj

raj: yup, my quick trace shows per-block smem usage increased from ~28KB to ~48KB, which reduces occupancy on A100-like cards. lower occupancy -> less overlapping warps -> memory BW stalls.

benchbot: automated benchmark (commit f3b9a2) 1769703480:
```
model: redwood-7b
seq: 8192
batch: 1
kernel: fused-FA-32x32
p99: 210ms -> 236ms (+12.4%)
sm_efficiency: 0.62 -> 0.45
l2_bw: 420GB/s -> 610GB/s
smem_per_block: 28KB -> 48KB
```

matt: thanks. that l2 spike aligns with my perf counters. two hypotheses: 1) tiling change increases sharedmem thrash leading to kv cache spilling, 2) pipeline stage ordering now creates a synchronization point that prevents streaming loads. can we try a 24x48 tiling (less per-block smem) and a pipeline reorder that issues KV loads earlier?

raj: i'll run a quick matrix: tilings [32x32, 24x48, 16x64] x pipeline stages [orig, early-kv, split-warp] on a4g and a100 shapes. aim to get samples by EOD. also will instrument per-block kv-eviction count.

sara: for batching heuristics — we should cap token-based dynamic batching for long-history chats until we stabilize kernel. currently batcher aggregates by tokens only, and these extremely long seqs create single-request whole-seq kernels that amplify the regression. propose soft cap at 6k tokens and fallback to chunked streaming.

matt: good call. can we add a toggle in runtime to force chunked streaming for model routes that hit p99 thresholds? quick patch would help customers while we tune kernel.

infra-bot: deploy log: feature/streaming-toggle rolled out to staging at 1769704400, no errors.

raj: first numbers for 24x48 + early-kv (a100): p99 218ms (+3.8%), sm_eff 0.58, l2_bw 460GB/s, smem_per_block 36KB. kv-evictions dropped ~40% in microtrace. looks promising.

matt: excellent. can someone attach the perf traces to the issue? i'll open a short RFC: swap tiling default to 24x48 and add runtime toggle for chunked streaming + batching cap.

sara: adding notes: watch for any regressions on short-seq latency and throughput. will run full perf suite. :eyes:

matt: thanks all — keep the thread updated. if raj's longer runs hold, we can ship the tiling rollback + runtime mitigation tomorrow.
